we have identified a novel, specific and potent inhibitor of ATM, which is a kinase that signals to cell cycle arrest and DNA repair.
we have identified a novel, specific inhibitor of the ATM protein kinase.

the development of small molecules that target the DNA damage response pathway.
the development of novel inhibitors of the phosphatidyinositol 3-kinase–related protein kinase family.

the compound KU-5593 is a novel and specific inhibitor of the ATM protein kinase.

the inhibition of ATM kinase activity by KU-58933 results in the sensitization of cells to ionizing radiation, and this effect is specific to cells with wild-type ATM.
